values.goal: Produce one accepted GCP hierarchy and cost-envelope decision.
values.required_outcome: A reviewed decision register binding organization, folders, projects, billing, region, quota, naming, data residency, and first workload cost ceiling without mutating GCP.
authority_boundary: Issue #490 owns only read-only GCP hierarchy and cost decision truth.
Issue #491 owns GCP Terraform bootstrap after #490.
No GCP mutation, API enablement, project creation, or paid launch is authorized by #490.
operator_constraints: Use the company account via gcloud auth login context; do not require a static key.
Do not print, copy, commit, or expose GCP credential material.
Use only read-only GCP discovery commands.
Keep work in a bound FastWork issue worktree before tracked implementation edits.
Obtain fresh exact-head review before publication.
